column1: # The renderer job's parts (.github/workflows/build.yml), each a process of build/test.py's --layout
# on lavapipe. A line holds a part's number, a test class or one case of a class by its display
# name, and its minutes on the runners' Xeon 6975P-C, the processor that ran most of their parts,
# from the build run of eef32314, a case of a part that ran on another processor scaled by that
# processor's time against the 6975P-C's, the median over the parts' runs since they were last laid
# out, the EPYC 9V45's 0.75, the EPYC 9V74's 0.98, the EPYC 7763's 1.33 and the Xeon 8370C's 1.47,
# the slowest. A class goes whole into a part, and global illumination's, the bounce rooms', the
# trees' leaves' and the trees' level shadows' by their cases. The lines are dealt from the longest
# into fourteen parts, each to the part holding least, the trees' leaves never in a part with
# global illumination, so the parts come out alike, some 26 minutes each on the 6975P-C, 20 on the
# 9V45 and 38 on the 8370C, where twelve parts of 31 minutes came to 45 there and one ran past the
# job's limit. The part holding * takes every test no other line names, the classes that draw
# nothing, a class or a case added since, and the cases that skip themselves on a device that draws
# on the processor, its minutes theirs.
